title: The /admin/qr visual check stops failing on every render: the check-in code previews, signed per second since LIVE-688, are one registered mask site
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1697), one of the three regressions LIVE-213's recapture (#3109) left on main. THE CONSEQUENCE: the four /admin/qr visual looks failed pr-compare on every run, with a different pixel count on each retry. MEASURED on #3109: two captures of the same tree about 30 minutes apart (runs 36667124353, 36676490803) agreed on 114 of 118 files and differed only on the four admin-qr files, in 96 x 96 bands over the check-in QR codes. LIVE-688 (ADR-1654) signs each node code over (node id, issued-at in unix seconds), and app/(main)/admin/qr/page.tsx signs a fresh one (signedNodeUrl) on every render, so the encoded URL and every module change from one second to the next. THE FIX, picture only: in NodeCard (qr-studio.tsx) the SVG is inlined by an h-full w-full square inside the fixed w-28 h-28 p-1.5 white frame (98 px), and that square carries data-visual-mask="qr-node-code", registered in VISUAL_MASK_SITES (test/e2e/surfaces.ts) as kind live with its reason citing LIVE-688. The frame fixes the square's size, so the mask holds (visual-masks.test.ts guards registry and tree both ways). The first cut masked the 112 px frame itself; on the mobile baseline the previews are centred, and LIVE-458's probe reads the tallest solid mask run down the centre as the scans chart, so a 119 px QR mask was read in the chart's place and check:backlog failed. Masking the code square, under 112 px, keeps both probes true. The signing is untouched: the issued-at is the code's security meaning. The other previews on the page (dynamic links, marketing and member profile codes) encode unsigned /q/<slug> URLs and stay in the picture, as do each card's label, badges, counts and actions. The four admin-qr baselines are recaptured through e2e-manual.yml (update_baselines + capture_shell) against this branch's preview, because a newly masked box paints differently from a baseline taken without it. Readings in the PR body.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const fail=(m)=>{console.error("LIVE-736: "+m);process.exit(1)};const read=(f)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(f))fail(f+" is gone");return fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")};const Q=read("app/(main)/admin/qr/qr-studio.tsx");const at=Q.indexOf("__html: node.svg");if(at<0)fail("the check-in code preview (node.svg) is no longer rendered in qr-studio.tsx");const open=Q.lastIndexOf("<div",at);const el=Q.slice(open,Q.indexOf("/>",at));if(!/data-visual-mask="qr-node-code"/.test(el))fail("the element that inlines the check-in code is not marked data-visual-mask=\"qr-node-code\", so every render of /admin/qr differs in the visual suite (LIVE-688 signs a per-second issued-at)");const frame=Q.slice(Q.lastIndexOf("<div",open-1),open);if(!/\bw-28\b/.test(frame)||!/\bh-28\b/.test(frame)||!/\bp-1\.5\b/.test(frame))fail("the masked code is no longer inside the fixed w-28 h-28 p-1.5 frame, so the mask box can resize or grow to the frame (a 112 px mask is read as the scans chart by LIVE-458)");if(!/\bh-full\b/.test(el)||!/\bw-full\b/.test(el))fail("the masked code square does not fill the frame content box, so its size is no longer fixed by the frame");const S=read("test/e2e/surfaces.ts");const reg=S.slice(S.indexOf("export const VISUAL_MASK_SITES"));const i=reg.indexOf("value: \x27qr-node-code\x27");if(i<0)fail("VISUAL_MASK_SITES has no qr-node-code row");const row=reg.slice(i,reg.indexOf("},",i));if(!row.includes("file: \x27app/(main)/admin/qr/qr-studio.tsx\x27"))fail("the qr-node-code row names the wrong file");if(!/LIVE-688/.test(row))fail("the qr-node-code reason does not cite LIVE-688");const g=S.indexOf("export const GLOBAL_MASK_SELECTORS");if(!/\[data-visual-mask\]/.test(S.slice(g,g+400)))fail("the global mask list no longer applies [data-visual-mask]");const N=read("lib/qr/node-code.ts");if(!/export function signNodeCode\(nodeId: string, issuedAtMs: number = Date\.now\(\)\)/.test(N))fail("signNodeCode no longer signs the current issued-at; LIVE-736 masks the picture and must not change the signing");for(const t of ["dawn-light-desktop","dawn-dark-desktop","dawn-light-mobile","dawn-dark-mobile"]){const p="test/e2e/__screenshots__/visual.spec.ts/admin-qr--"+t+".png";if(!fs.existsSync(p))fail(p+" is gone")}console.log("LIVE-736: each check-in code on /admin/qr is a registered mask site (qr-node-code) on the square inside its fixed w-28 h-28 frame, and the per-second signing is unchanged")'
